notes.title: DAILY DEAL AT 10AM PST/1PM EST TODAY, SEPTEMBER 3RD + Progress Report!
notes.content:
[h1]NOTE - This is NOT a new patch, this is just what we've been working on![/h1][p]
-------------------------------
[h3]DAILY DEAL ON STEAM![/h3]

So to start off with, before we get to what we've gotten done-- [b]there's a front-page Daily Deal for Future Fragments right now![/b]

We planned this out a while back, and yes, it just happened to land on September 3rd, the day before, well, yeah.

But it is what it is; we'd love for you to play our game too, and enjoy it alongside any other games you're likely going to play that are coming out tomorrow.

[b]For anyone new here;[/b] we're a team of 3 core people (one programmer, one artist, one writer/level designer, all co-game designers), as well as a musician and an audio engineer doing work as-needed.

We've put well over $200,000 of our own money into this game's content, and are currently facing down about $80,000 in debt as a result of it (taxes hit pretty hard, as does cost of living!)

So pretty much all of you supporting us is what allows us to continue to make and finish off the last parts of a game this large and content-dense, despite being such a small-sized team.

We can't thank you enough, seriously. This game would literally not be possible if not for your support, and we definitely plan to make many, many more games after this, all set in the same universe with an overarching storyline.

-------------------------------
[h3]What we've gotten done since the last patch![/h3]

Frouge has been going pretty crazy fixing a gigantic list of bugs as well as a brand new Save system that will auto-save your progress on each level, so you can easily return to a given level if you'd like to do things differently, even if you forgot to save in that level.

It also has additional information now for each save, such as total time played and amount of collectibles found.

Here's an image of it; you can see the auto-saves at the bottom of the list.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37781047/397c929406278df7590a03ebe924c697ffe62b0a.png[/img]
For the cutscenes and similar things, while it may not seem like a large list, these remaining cutscenes are [i]gigantic[/i] in terms of variants and outcomes.

As an example, [spoiler]Kataskopoi & Dolon's[/spoiler] scene has a whopping [i]89 variants[/i].
The [spoiler]Celodst Emperor[/spoiler] scene goes even farther than this, with [i]104 variants[/i], plus a secret event and Faux Ending attached to it.

[h3]CUTSCENE FIXES / ADDITIONS:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Added [spoiler]Vines Fragment scene in P5M4 of the Uncharted Wildwoods[/spoiler]
[*]Added [spoiler]Auxiliary Appendage scene in P4M1 of the Uncharted Wildwoods[/spoiler]
[*]Added [spoiler]Celodst Emperor scene in full[/spoiler]
[*]Added another [spoiler]Faux Ending[/spoiler]
[*]Added [spoiler]Kataskopoi and Dolon Fragment scene in P2M3 of the Celodst Resupply[/spoiler]
[*]Added [spoiler]Stjarna Vattenodla scene in Room 19 of The End[/spoiler]
[*]Added [spoiler]Laser Puzzle Fragment scene in the Celodst Resupply[/spoiler]
[*]Added a hint scene for the [spoiler]Laser Celodst's role in getting the Laser Puzzle Fragment in the Celodst Resupply[/spoiler]
[*]Added a hint scene for platforming in [spoiler]P2M5a of the Uncharted Wildwoods[/spoiler]
[*]Re-added the improved four True Endings
[*]Added a few extra variants to cutscenes in [spoiler]The End to reference an existing "global event"[/spoiler]
[*]Fixed some errors in recordings in the [spoiler]Hub of the Gratification Factory[/spoiler]
[*]Added an extra line for a rare event with [spoiler]Clean in the Uncharted Wildwoods[/spoiler]
[/list]

[h3]OTHER CHANGES / FIXES / ADDITIONS:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed the bug that's plagued things for a while with the Mega Map vanishing if you enter a new module while the minimap is disabled
[*]Fixed the wrong "door" size between [spoiler]Room 13 and the Hub in The End[/spoiler]
[*]Databanks had a few missing words fixed on them, especially #147 (Projekt Melody Databank #2)
[*]Fixed equipping a powerup during a cutscene and the powerup's effect incorrectly apply to Talia during that cutscene (potentially breaking/softlocking the cutscene)
[*]Fixed being able to jump over the [spoiler]ADMN Spawner with certain powerups[/spoiler]
[*]Fixed zoom/graphics not being drawn properly on a few gallery animations in certain situations
[*]Fixed being stunned by the [spoiler]Mega Mutabilis carrying over into the victory cutscene if it dies while it's stunned[/spoiler]
[*]Fixed the [spoiler]Infected Rebel vine attack animation not pausing if the game is paused[/spoiler]
[*]Fixed charges not maintaining when going from module to module
[*]Fixed multiple "initialization scene" bugs, including Talia jumping up into a new map sometimes causing her to just "glide" into the new map visually and GUI flickering
[*]Fixed multiple visual issues with Powerup indicator bars (such as the one for the Drumset) vanishing, staying despite unequipping, freezing, etc.
[*]Fixed the poison effect from the Coral powerup so it works on all enemies
[*]Fixed the Sewing Needles powerup combo so it properly increments on the [spoiler]Mega Mutabilis and breakable walls during the ADMN Spawner fight[/spoiler]
[*]Fixed the Peace Symbol powerup so it works properly against the [spoiler]Arctic Grunt and Sphere[/spoiler]
[*]Fixed the French Frying Pan powerup causing an animation hiccup when gaining health while running
[*]Fixed the Japanese Knife powerup shockwaves so they properly collide with [spoiler]Tile-Growers and Gravity Doors[/spoiler]
[*]Fixed the Japanese Knife powerup shockwave's lighting effect being misaligned with the shockwave sprite
[*]Fixed the Hammer powerup instant shots so they properly collide with [spoiler]Gravity Doors, Tile-Growers and various Switches[/spoiler]
[*]Fixed the Hammer powerup instant shots so they become visible normal shots when fired over a Savepad or near an [spoiler]Electric Cannon[/spoiler]
[*]Fixed the Hammer powerup instant shots so they stay invisible after bouncing on an [spoiler]Ice mirror wall[/spoiler]
[*]Fixed the Hammer powerup instant shots so they can properly hit moving platforms in the [spoiler]Uncharted Wildwoods[/spoiler]
[*]Fixed triggering a cutscene while wearing any powerups that affects Talia's max health, so that it doesn't reduce her HP by 1 unintentionally due to a rounding error
[*]Fixed un-equipping the Treadmill powerup while at low health being able to reduce Talia's health below 0, putting her in a bugged state
[*]Changed the HUD health bar to shrink or grow based on powerups which affect Talia's max health, to make her current max health more apparent
[*]Changed the color for powerup indicator bars (such as the Drumset) from blue to yellow to make them easier to see on all levels
[*]Added a number on the HUD to display the current Max Health bonus of the Treadmill powerup while equipped
[*]Added a number on the HUD to display the current overheal amount of the Protein Drink powerup while equipped
[*]Added SFX to a few powerups
[*]Added missing [spoiler]WREN CG to the gallery[/spoiler]
[*]Added a lot of new SFX in general
[/list]
-------------------------------

[h3]What's next?[/h3]

As a reminder from the last update, after the "core content complete patch" is out, we'll be focusing on free DLC for the game, including, but not limited to:
[list]
[*] The level editor
[*] Speedrun mode
[*] More NPCs
[*] "Challenge" map packs
[/list]
And of course any bugfixes needed.
[/p][h2]That's all for now, until the core content complete patch; we're looking forward to having things complete for you all!

And once you've tried the game out, we'd like your feedback on it in a review if you get the chance![/h2][p]
-------------------------------

notes.content:
[h1]PATCH #7 IS NOW LIVE![/h1][p]
-------------------------------

This patch has a small handful of [b]gameplay quality of life improvements and bugfixes[/b], as well as [b]a significant assortment of new sound effects added[/b].

However, [b]there's a LOT more we've got done behind the scenes that'll be in the next patch[/b], but we didn't want to put it in until it was 100% complete.

And speaking of that next patch, we're happy to announce that [i]the next patch will have all remaining story segments left without voicework or finalized script finished off![/i]

[h2]This "core content complete patch" will release during September 2025 if all goes well.[/h2]

After that patch is out, we'll be focusing on free DLC for the game, including, but not limited to:
[list]
[*] The level editor
[*] Speedrun mode
[*] More NPCs
[*] "Challenge" map packs
[/list]
And of course any bugfixes needed.

[b]We're also doing a 1 week sale for this patch for 20% off, as a celebration for having locked in a date for the "all core content in" patch, starting the minute this post goes up![/b]

notes.title: Patch #6 for Future Fragments IS NOW LIVE!
notes.content:
[h1]PATCH #6 IS NOW LIVE![/h1]

-------------------------------

This patch has a good chunk of [b]major gameplay quality of life improvements[/b], as well as a number of [b]bugfixes and additions to the gallery[/b]; the next patch should be [i]significantly beefy story-wise.[/i]

The notes themselves go into a bit more detail than usual, so we'll just let those speak for themselves about all the new additions/fixes.

[b]We're also doing a 1 week sale for this patch, as sort of a post-Easter sale, for 10% off, starting May 1st at 1AM PST![/b]

-------------------------------

[h3]BIG CHANGES / ADDITIONS / FIXES:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Added a button prompt to trigger an instant upwards boost when Talia is hovering at the top of an air stream from an air vent in the Volcanic Mines
[*]Added the missing animations to the gallery [spoiler](Talia self-pleasure, Mega Mutabilis holding Vie, the stealth area ones, etc.)[/spoiler]
[*]Added a special "leeway" mechanic to [spoiler]Talia's freeze shot ability, where it should now be significantly easier to hit and freeze fast-moving targets, such as the projectiles fired by the cannons in the Gratification Factory[/spoiler]
[*]Added a brief tutorial text after defeating the [spoiler]ADMN Spawner and moving into the first "In-Between" Module, that shows the controls for the fire dash and the fire charge shot, as well as informing about the ability to toggle auto-charging in the options menu[/spoiler]
[*]Added new, unique visual hit effect for Talia's basic shots
[*]Added voicework for the [spoiler]Gratification Factory and Uncharted Wildwoods[/spoiler] Gold Databanks
[*]Adjusted the ice platforms created by [spoiler]Talia's freeze shot ability to have their collision box made 25% wider, to make it easier to jump to and from the ice blocks (the visuals haven't changed, only the collision box size)[/spoiler]
[*]Adjusted the [spoiler]stealth section to allow Talia to take 2 hits before being KO'd instead of 1 to make it easier[/spoiler]
[*]Adjusted the Volcanic Mines Hard #4 Achievement for finishing a path without taking damage and the [spoiler]Gratification Factory Hard #2 Achievement for finishing a path with a Negative powerup[/spoiler] so that they can now both be obtained from re-doing already completed paths
[*]Fixed a crash that happened as a result of having [spoiler]Celodst Resupply Laser Puzzles solved or not solved in certain circumstances[/spoiler]
[*]Fixed crouching not panning the camera down correctly since the latest patch
[*]Fixed an issue with a specific version of the Pacifism Ideal bonus you can get from not killing any enemies on a Path; [spoiler]since Vie requires you to kill enemies in the last room of Paths within the Gratification Factory, you can now get this bonus despite killing said enemies as long as you still don't kill any enemies in any previous rooms on that given Path[/spoiler]
[/list]
[h3]CUTSCENE FIXES / ADDITIONS:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Adjusted a scene with the the shadowy lady [spoiler]so she won't help with the Fragment-based Laser Puzzle if she's already left the Celodst Resupply due to Talia losing too many times against the Celodst Emperor[/spoiler]
[*]Removed the "hint" scene for the Volcanic Mines air vents before entering the actual Hub Room, now that Talia can just boost off of the air stream without needing timing to do so
[*]Fixed a rare situation with [spoiler]Nate Allen in P6M1 of the Uncharted Wildwoods[/spoiler] where his scene would start up despite him having been killed prior
[*]Fixed an issue with the shadowy lady [spoiler]helping you solve Laser Puzzles in the Celodst Resupply, in that if you chose to have her solve the first one but refused help with the second, it would still have her solve all of them[/spoiler]
[*]Fixed an issue with a scene on [spoiler]End Map 20 that would lead Talia to mention Shea, despite being on a story path that prevents Shea from appearing there to begin with[/spoiler]
[/list]
[h3]OTHER CHANGES / FIXES / ADDITIONS:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Added missing SFX for [spoiler]Talia's self-pleasure animation as well as the stealth area animations[/spoiler]
[*]Added missing vibration SFX for the relevant [spoiler]Gratification Factory enemies in the gallery (so the gallery matches the in-game SFX for those enemies)[/spoiler]
[*]Added a new music track for [spoiler]Vie's Hideout[/spoiler]
[*]Added new graphical effect for [spoiler]Vie's Cyber Mines during her battle, to help further highlight them visually when they're primed[/spoiler]
[*]Added new animations for the [spoiler]Celodst Resupply Laser Puzzle target rings, to make them easier to spot and to differentiate if they are lit up or not[/spoiler]
[*]Added "off" variants for the [spoiler]Uncharted Wildwoods databanks, so you can tell if you've collected them already like in other levels[/spoiler]
[*]Added in new visual for the switches in [spoiler]The End, giving them a distinct look in both realms[/spoiler]
[*]Added new functionality to the [spoiler]Celodst Resupply Laser Puzzles to prevent the shadowy lady from appearing to help you for a given puzzle if you'd already solved it[/spoiler]
[*]Adjusted multiple Modules within the [spoiler]Celodst Resupply to give more opportunities to get the Ice Hard #3 Achievement[/spoiler]
[*]Adjusted the visual hit effect for Talia's [spoiler]fire charge shot[/spoiler]
[*]Adjusted the duration of shots bounced off of [spoiler]ice mirrors in the Celodst Resupply, making it less frustrating to try to obtain the Ice Hard #3 Achievement[/spoiler]
[*]Adjusted [spoiler]P5M4 in the Volcanic Mines to make crossing the lava make more sense with the fans[/spoiler]
[*]Fixed [spoiler]Jumper Bot animations being vertically misaligned in the gallery[/spoiler]
[*]Fixed [spoiler]diagonal shots being visually rotated incorrectly after bouncing on a ice mirror[/spoiler]
[/list]
-------------------------------

[h2]That's all for now, until the next patch; we'll keep working and adding to the game until it's fully complete!

And once you've tried the patch out, we'd like your feedback on it in a review if you get the chance![/h2]

notes.title: Patch #5 for Future Fragments IS NOW LIVE!
notes.content:
[h1]PATCH #5 IS NOW LIVE![/h1]

-------------------------------

This patch has a huge number of bugfixes, but most notably, it also has some significant gameplay changes and additions:

[b]Finally, the full Gallery is in the game[/b]! It'll be retroactively unlocked for those who've already done so, but if you haven't, you'll need 5 Achievements per level, out of 10. However, if you get all 10 achievements in a level, (for the first four levels only), you'll also get a special POV animation not seen anywhere else in the game [i](it's not some huge thing, just to temper your expectations).[/i]

And there's more than H-scenes in the gallery, too; there's also a list of the [b]True Endings[/b] [i](which you can re-watch)[/i] and the [b]Faux Endings[/b] [i](you'll be able to re-watch those next patch).[/i]

There's also [b]Vie's Hideout[/b], a bonus mode within the Gallery that'll unlock once you've gotten at least one True Ending, where all the H-animations in the game will randomly cycle, aided by Vie's commentary about what's going on [i](you can toggle this on/off).[/i]

A new functionality addition is the [b]Auto-Charge Shot[/b] option, so for those of you who don't like holding the button down to fire off Charge Shots, you can now enable this in the options menu, after the first level, to have Talia's Charge Shot constantly charging.

Speaking of making things a bit easier, [b]there's been a few "hint" cutscenes added to areas that some of you have said you have trouble with[/b] (they'll play after you've been there a bit), as well as a series of cutscenes/functionality that will allow you to auto-solve the Laser Puzzle rooms if you're totally stuck on them, or just don't like doing those sorts of puzzles.

And [b]to make navigation easier[/b], you can now see the Module you're in, under the minimap.

Finally, [b]we've also made two of the in-game achievements easier[/b], since those were notoriously hard for people to find, and not in a fun way.

-------------------------------

[b]The shooting change alone for this patch should make the game's combat feel much smoother/different[/b], not to mention the changes to [spoiler]the WREN fight in The End[/spoiler]; there's also a lot of bugfixes, cutscene additions, and more!

[h2]HOW TO REFRESH/UPDATE TO THE NEW PATCH:[/h2]

In the steam client, right click on the game in your library list, select properties from the dropdown list, then in the Local files tab select Verify integrity of game cache.

If everything verifies correctly then you should have the latest patched release on the Steam servers.

-------------------------------

[h3]SHOOTING/ATTACK MECHANICS CHANGE:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Shooting (normal shots) has had a small, but very significant change
[*]Mashing the attack button will now allow you to fire as fast as you want, up to a maximum cap
[*]This should make shooting feel a LOT smoother and certain enemies/bosses indirectly easier to defeat
[/list]

[h3]STEAM ACHIEVEMENTS ADDED:[/h3]
[list]
[*]All 50 in-game achievements are now Steam Achievements as well
[*]If you'd unlocked achievements prior, you'll have them automatically unlocked through this patch
[*]Additionally, all 50 in-game achievements are now completely achievable (there were some that weren't in prior versions)
[*]There will be more Steam Achievements added in future patches, too
[/list]

[h3][spoiler]WREN[/spoiler] (BOSS OF THE END) FIGHT REBALANCING:[/h3]
[list] 
[*][spoiler]While we won't be giving this treatment to any other bosses in the game, WREN was frustrating a significant amount of people, so we've decided to weaken him for this patch[/spoiler]
[*][spoiler]We'll likely rebalance him in the future based on player feedback from this version of him, too[/spoiler]
[*][spoiler]For those disappointed in this change, WREN might get an optional "superboss" version of him in the future, which will make him far harder than he was even before this patch[/spoiler]
[*][spoiler]Here's the specific changes we made to him though:[/spoiler]
[list][*][spoiler]Removed 1 "cycle" of the fight, you only have to beat two phases now, instead of a second loop of the same two phases[/spoiler]
[*][spoiler]His movement speed (running, dashing) reduced by 10%[/spoiler]

[*][spoiler]Added a minor extra delay of "telegraphing" certain moves before performing them (dashing, uppercutting, jumping)[/spoiler]
[*][spoiler]All of his damage output reduced by 10%[/spoiler]
[*][spoiler]Shield duration (time between WREN's shield swapping colour) increased by 50% (from 5 seconds to 7.5 seconds)[/spoiler]
[*][spoiler]Shield health also reduced by 10%[/spoiler]
[*][spoiler]WREN's Phase 2 health reduced by 10%[/spoiler][/list]
[*]If players are still unable to win, we've added an optional further reduction the game will prompt the player with; if they choose to do so, all of [spoiler]WREN's[/spoiler] stats/values will be reduced a further 20%

notes.title: Update on lowering the difficulty for the "Final Boss"
notes.content:
So, after many, many people have expressed frustration with him, and after a lot of deliberation, we've decided the following changes will be made to the "final boss" [i](not the true final boss)[/i] of Future Fragments in the [b]next patch[/b].

Hopefully, these changes will make things more accessible to the majority of players/not as frustrating.

[list]
[*][spoiler]The fight will be lowered to 1 cycle of 2 phases, instead of 2 cycles of 2 phases [i](as people hated getting through one cycle and then losing and having to start from the beginning)[/i][/spoiler]
[*][spoiler]His health, attack damage, movement speed, and shield health will be lowered by 10%[/spoiler]
[*][spoiler]The speed at which his shield cycles will be reduced by 50% [i](as this was one of the biggest pain points, having to switch skills super fast)[/i][/spoiler]
[*][spoiler]If you're still having trouble with him, there will be a cutscene that will appear after 10 losses where you'll have the [b]OPTION[/b] of making him even easier[/spoiler]
[*][spoiler]For those who want a challenge, we [i]will[/i] be retaining the original fight to be able to access in-game in a later patch through some sort of method[/spoiler]
[/list]

We realize that some of you really enjoyed the challenge the boss brings, but the amount of people who've reported being frustrated with it is just really, really high.

If this ends up being TOO drastic of a change, we'll try to find a middle ground where he's still weaker than he is now, but not AS much.

In general, we want Future Fragments to be fun and present a [i]challenge[/i], but we're also aware what [i]type[/i] of game it is, so we want it to be accessible to most players too.

[i]For those that want a challenge in general too, once everything is done with the game, I'll be making free DLC map packs of extremely hard maps/challenges, so we're not going to neglect those who want really brutal difficulties![/i]

notes.content:

--------------------------------------

[b]Bit of a long post this time, but I'll try to make it as brief as I can![/b]

---------------------------

To start off, we switched the numbers to make it so that it shows the number of [i]cutscenes completed[/i], instead of the number of cutscenes [i]left[/i], so that we could also show how many cutscenes/databanks are in the game total.

And just to get this clarification out of the way, those of you with good math skills will realize that 388 - 210 = 178 left to go, which is a bit more than last week's amount of 157 left to go.

The reason for this is because on our end, [b]some of the cutscenes in the game are grouped together for ease of finding them/similarity.[/b]

However, we realized this gives a skewed view of how many actual [i]individual cutscenes[/i] there are in the game. [b](This isn't counting "tabs" or "variants" on scenes; if we count that, we're probably at somewhere around 1,000+ total for the final game!)[/b]

For instance, every one of "Shadow Vie's" cutscenes in the Fire Level were grouped as just "one cutscene", despite her cutscenes happening on entirely different maps with entirely different content per event.

Similarly, all the cutscenes when you reach the end of a path in a level were grouped as "one cutscene" per level too.

[b]The number you see there now is a much more accurate amount of how many cutscenes/databanks are in the game right now and working, and how many will be in the game at launch.[/b]

---------------------------

As far as programming goes, Frouge has just been generally adding general things around the game; this might not sound like much, but trust me, he's been getting a lot of stuff done.

Most of it is spoiler stuff, as usual, but I can say these things as specifics;

- We now have more NPC functionality in that I needed for cutscenes in general, as well as specialized stuff for certain cutscenes that should make some cutscenes really "pop".

- We also have in this neat feature for people whose primary language isn't English; you can press CTRL+C to copy any text on-screen and then paste it into a translation program, which should help lots until we get localizations officially done in different languages (after-launch).

- Global cutscenes are now a thing; these would be things like secret endings or other events that can happen on any map, instead of being locked to a specific map. This functionality was needed for both the secret endings and other cutscenes that I'd want to happen by tracking player actions over the course of the game (or over a series of maps, like the pre-boss puzzle rooms in the Electric Level).

- Most of the remaining music has been added in game and is usable in cutscenes now.
